name: The Gentleman's Pipe Starter Set
description: Everything a new pipe smoker needs, curated by our head tobacconist and presented in a mahogany-finish gift box. Includes a Missouri Meerschaum Country Gentleman, a 1.75oz tin of Cornell & Diehl Autumn Evening, a Czech pipe tool, ten pipe cleaners, and our 12-page guide to pipe smoking written in house. The ideal first step into a lifelong pursuit.

name: The Collector's Gift Box
description: For the seasoned smoker who has everything, and deserves something exceptional. A hand-selected estate briar pipe in restored condition, three 50g tins of our finest English mixtures, a sterling silver pipe tamper, a cedar spill bundle, and a personal note written by our founder. Presented in a velvet-lined lacquered box. Call us to discuss personalisation.
